scope: Phase 10E public keyboard re-validation after forward-fixing shifted modifier delivery timing

prerequisiteEvidence.publicS01Finding: plain a and Enter passed end-to-end; Shift+A product result passed but the independent fixture did not observe the shifted lifecycle when events were posted without inter-event settling

forwardFix.product: insert short internal settling intervals between Shift-down, key-down, key-up and Shift-up; no public contract change
forwardFix.poc: forward-fix two stale documentation guards and add a regression guard for modifier-delivery settling

physicalOracle.type: AppKit NSTextView in a separate process
physicalOracle.plainA: exactly one down/up plus lowercase consequence
physicalOracle.enter: exactly one down/up plus newline consequence
physicalOracle.shiftedA: exactly one Shift on/off plus shifted key down/up and uppercase consequence

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility environment prevents the product helper, runtime or independent fixture from compiling or executing.
resultPolicy.FAIL: The public contract, independent delivery/consequence, modifier lifecycle, restoration, privacy or semantic-boundary invariant fails.
resultPolicy.PASS: The real public SDK path posts all three grounded keyboard tuples with the delivery-only boundary while the independent AppKit oracle confirms exact delivery, consequences and cleanup.

nextStepOnPass: Promote keyboard.press to PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED without changing the validated runtime and close Phase 10A-10E low-level mechanics.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not promote keyboard.press.
